question: Whether opening a country screen clears the selection, and through what.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::OpenCountryView
addresses.comment: **Opens country view `index`, or closes it when it is the one open - and clears the selection either way.** Where any view is open (AnyCountryViewOpen): notes whether view[index] is (its slot 7), then every open view gets slot 5 and slot 4 (Hide) and +0x1914 is hidden. +0xCFC = index; the side menus closed (CInGameIdler_CloseSideMenus). Where view[index] was open, +0x1920, +0x1918 and +0x191C are shown again and nothing is opened - the toggle. Otherwise those three are hidden; where the statistics ledger is open (+0x1CE0) its page noted (+0x1D40), its close asked (+0x1D3D) and +0x1914 hidden; CInGameIdler_ShowMenuBackground; view[index] slot 8 then slot 2 (Show). On both paths: +0x1D34 (diplomessageicons_window) slot 11, the top bar (+0x1318) slot 3, the custom game settings' first byte choosing the top bar's +0x20 slot 11 or +0x131C's slots 5 and 2, and **last its own slot 46, CInGameIdler::ClearSelection** (0x6658F3) - every selected unit and province let go and the orders window closed. Callers: the six top-bar buttons (diplomacy 0, production 1, technology 2, politics 3, intelligence 4, theatres 5), a view's close_button (CCountryView::OnClose), the alerts (CInGameIdler::OnAlertClicked: 'diplomacy' 0, 'industry' 1, 'technology' 2, 'politics' 3, 'intel' 4), the statistics ledger's opener, message Gotos and some thirty others. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-countryviews.md, section 7.
addresses.revises: the elided middle and the shared tail read: the selection cleared on both paths (slot 46 at 0x6658F3); confidence inferred -> confirmed
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x6656D0..0x6658FB: the two paths join at 0x665845; `mov edx,[esi]; mov eax,[edx+0xB8]; mov ecx,esi; call eax` at 0x6658F1 with esi the idler; slot 46 of CInGameIdler is CInGameIdler::ClearSelection (0x656CD0), the same slot close_multiunit's thunk calls.

addresses.name: CCountryView::OnClose
addresses.comment: **`close_button` of every country screen** (the glue at +0x7C, bound by CCountryView::CCountryView). Unless +0xB4 is set, where any screen is up (AnyCountryViewOpen), CInGameIdler::OpenCountryView(idler +0xB0, the idler's current view +0xCFC) - the toggle on the screen that is up, which shuts it and clears the selection. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-countryviews.md, section 7.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x6EB290..0x6EB2C2, bare ret, ECX the view: `cmp byte [edi+0xb4],0; jne; mov esi,[edi+0xb0]; call 0x665280; ...; push [ecx+0xcfc]; call 0x6656d0`. CCountryView::CCountryView writes 0x6EB290 at 0x6EB114 into the glue at +0x7C that close_button is given.
